prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a replacement obstacle SPRITE for the actual existing game shown in reference image 1. Image 1 is the art-direction authority: flat muted tan track, sage grass, sparse pixels, warm golden timber fence along the upper edge, tiny side-view horses. Image 2 is the exact original brown horse sprite, 26x18 native pixels enlarged, for pixel-density reference. The new obstacle must look drawn by the SAME ARTIST AS THE TRACKSIDE FENCE, at the SAME coarse pixel size as the horse. It is a modest rustic timber jump, with plain warm weathered wooden rails and slim stakes made from exactly the upper fence's muted golden timber. Use ONLY 4 flat matte wood colors: #D0AE72 light edge, #AD874F main wood, #81623E shade, #624C32 darkest contact. No painted white or red bands, no dark chocolate sports columns, no polished surfaces, no beveled ornamental caps, no heavy base blocks, no 3D illustration shading. Silhouette and simple small flat clusters must supply readability. Each upright 2 logical pixels thick, each rail 2 logical pixels thick. Tiny 1-pixel light edge only. No texture, grain, noise, gradients, soft light, bloom, or antialiasing.
Crucial geometry: it crosses one racing lane, horses run left-to-right. Its depth direction runs from upper LEFT to lower RIGHT with a STEEP but natural diagonal, about 65 degrees from horizontal. Native source diagram: far stake top around (10,3), foot around (10,11); near stake top around (17,17), foot around (17,26). BOTH stakes are vertical in the image, rather than tilting the entire asset. Connect the stakes with a narrow wooden rail from around (10,6) to (17,20). This gives an obvious vertical height of the stakes plus shallow overhead depth, matching the slightly-above side-view horse environment. Do not turn the object into a flat pole lying on the ground, a front-view wide H, or a fully isometric 3D prop. Far stake is a little smaller, near stake has one dark SIDE pixel. At ground contacts at most 2 tiny dark pixels attached to the stakes, not a floating cast shadow or ground patch.
Total native silhouette is only about 15x27 pixels, on a logical 40x40 source canvas enlarged by integer nearest neighbor. Maintain these tiny coarse shapes. One complete object centered with generous transparent alpha margins, true transparent PNG. No environment, no horses, no text, no other objects. Design variant: one simple flat wooden crosspiece between the two stakes, plus a tiny plain short angled brace on the NEAR stake only. Keep plenty of empty air beneath the diagonal crosspiece. Neither stake has an ornamental foot. The warm tan rail is 2-3 pixels thick and stands out against dirt through a single dark underside pixel. Clean restrained silhouette. This is a low working farm hurdle, not a professional showjumping obstacle.
layoutChanges: Use warm matte timber matching the upper track fence.
Narrow horizontal presentation scale to 75 percent for the cross-lane view while preserving vertical supports; use a muted darker renderer tint for contrast on the dirt.
